entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, I think I need to return something? I bought these road cycling shoes, and I'm just so lost with the website. It's all a bit much.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

A fit thing, I guess? I wore them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but they just hurt so much. I don't understand what I'm doing wrong.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. Finding the right fit is crucial for comfort. It sounds like this particular model might not be the right shape for your foot.
I guess not. The return page online had all these rules and options... I just got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back and get a refund.

Of course. I can absolutely walk you through it. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received them just 7 days ago. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for shoes, so getting you a full refund is no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So I can get a refund? Thank you!

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return for you and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay, a shipping label in my email. I can do that. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
